description: As 2019 kicks off, we’re starting the year with a newcomer to the Darker Than Wax stable - Italian producer Ciro Mont. Straight out of the tiny and chaotic streets of Naples, Ciro Mont belongs to the current breed of artists and beat makers that's thriving in the local community, and with 'Unapologetic', he brings three aces to the table - soulful, layered grooves that bring some sunshine to the winter months. Danish vocalist Josephin Bovién graces the tracks ‘Baked w/ Badu’ and ‘Nvr’ with her signature modern RnB style, while instrumental ‘BlvntBossa’ blends smooth Latin sounds with footwork sensibilities. A strong first effort for the label, ‘Unapologetic’ is just the start of what’s to come for Ciro Mont.
credits:
